title: SQL Essential Training Chapter 4
description: Write and run SELECT queries with aliases, ORDER BY, and LIMIT against the WSDA Music database.

videos.title: Your First Query
videos.learning_objective: Write and run your first SELECT query to return a customer contact list
videos.discovery_objective: Open the Execute SQL tab, type the commented query SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer, run it with F5, and show the result pane with the contact list

exercise_artifact.description: WSDA Music Customer table with FirstName, LastName, Email.

planned_queries: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer;

videos.title: Aliases — Speaking Management's Language
videos.learning_objective: Use the AS keyword to give query results readable column headers
videos.discovery_objective: Open the Execute SQL tab, type SELECT FirstName AS First Name, LastName AS Last Name, Email AS Email Address FROM Customer, run it with F5, and show the aliased headers

exercise_artifact.description: WSDA Music Customer table with FirstName, LastName, Email.

planned_queries: SELECT FirstName AS "First Name", LastName AS "Last Name", Email AS "Email Address" FROM Customer;

videos.title: Sorting Results with ORDER BY
videos.learning_objective: Sort query results by a specific column using ORDER BY
videos.discovery_objective: Open the Execute SQL tab, type SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName, run it with F5, and show the result pane sorted by LastName

exercise_artifact.description: WSDA Music Customer table with FirstName, LastName, Email.

planned_queries: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName;

videos.title: Limiting Results with LIMIT
videos.learning_objective: Limit the number of returned rows using the LIMIT clause
videos.discovery_objective: Open the Execute SQL tab, type SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 5, run it with F5, and show exactly five rows in the result pane

exercise_artifact.description: WSDA Music Customer table with FirstName, LastName, Email.

planned_queries: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 5;

videos.title: Query Etiquette Recap
videos.learning_objective: Combine comment headers, aliases, ORDER BY, and LIMIT in one clean query
videos.discovery_objective: Open the Execute SQL tab, type a commented query that aliases columns, orders by LastName, and limits to 5 rows, run it with F5, and show the documented preview

exercise_artifact.description: WSDA Music Customer table with FirstName, LastName, Email.

planned_queries: SELECT FirstName AS "First Name", LastName AS "Last Name", Email AS "Email Address" FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 5;
